create_PlasmaArray_for_multiprocessing: create a PlasmaArray wrapper to move numpy arrays to shared memory on serialization for multiprocessing
start_PlasmaArray_server: start a PlasmaArray server to store large numpy arrays in shared memory via plasma_store
create_PlasmaView_for_shared_memory: create a PlasmaView to write and read numpy arrays from shared memory using a unique object ID
get_PlasmaView_object_id: get a PlasmaView object ID by hashing a split path and hashable metadata for shared memory lookup
start_PlasmaStore_server: start a PlasmaStore server with a configurable socket path and memory size for shared memory access
